maria: Postmortem follow-up: authz hit shows three recurring issues — token reuse edgecases, silent fallback paths with no audit, and a couple of long-lived service keys. Need owners + short timeline.
maria: Proposal: 9 business days for probes, audit hooks, and key rotations. Weekly 15m sync until done.
tom: I can handle probes. Plan: add a token-replay integration and a cron probe in staging. ETA 3 days to PR.
lee: I'll take audit coverage. Will add hooks in fallback codepaths and a backfill job for missed events. Need ~5 days.
security-bot: Note: rotation windows require dependency list for each service. Attach list before revoking keys.
maria: Owners: probes=tom, audit=lee, keys=ops. Post a rollback blurb + PRs here.
tom: PR incoming: github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/5201 — staging canary only. Also will test cached vs direct verification paths.
ci-bot: runtime#5201 CI started.
ops: Inventory done: svc-analytics key >120d. Scheduling rotation 3341004000-3341007600 UTC pending sec sign-off.
lee: Audit shim deployed to 2% canary in staging; events visible. Adding automated test to ensure fallback events have trace_id.
maria: Criteria to close: 72h green probes in staging, production audit events for fallback paths for 48h, keys rotated + TTL alerts in monitoring. I'll confirm and close.
lee: Backfill run scheduled tonight to re-emit missed fallback events for last 14 days.
tom: Probe merged and cron set. Watching for false negatives.
ops: Rotation executed for svc-analytics at 3341007000; old key revoked 3341070000.
maria: Thanks team — keep PRs/CI links here. Reopen if anything pops up. :thumbsup:
